text: chef's-choice toolkit RNA-seq splicing transcription-start-site figures. 'omakase' reads coverage junctions straight BAM/SAM files, rMATS event tables, STAR junction files, 5'-tag BEDs tidy data frames, renders publication-ready sashimi plots built 'ggplot2' 'patchwork'.
